title: World Bloom — Turning Pain Into Drive — Episode10 Back in Harmony

meta.Event Outline: The members of Vivid BAD SQUAD check in on the tree growing in the plaza of their SEKAI. Suddenly, each of them is thrown into a dream showing them a different life, in a world where their paths diverged...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, what is it that you need to tell me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: For belittling your dream the way I did.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's gotten into you all of a sudden...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I know I should have apologized much sooner.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I don't expect you to forgive me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've wanted to do this for quite a while now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You've wanted to apologize to me...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, that time, why did you...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I know you had a lot going on.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Is that all you wanted to say...?
If so, I'm gonna—

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Did you also hear them, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, but I couldn't make out what they were saying.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Could it have been people singing...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I don't actually know for sure, but...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You can leave if you want.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Someone's been singing for a while now...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I think it's coming from over here...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's like she's screaming, calling out to someone out of reach.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Akito? What are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa, you really startled me there! It's been forever!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I heard that you're over in the US now. What brought you back?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I had a thing to go to.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, I didn't know you were still singing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? Of course I'm still singing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, I'm going to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess your confidence hasn't wavered.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But that's not going to happen...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Because I'm going to surpass that night.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Then, let's throw down right here.
That's the easiest way to set the record straight.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think it's coming from over here...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (He must've been training pretty hard, but...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But I'm not about to let her win!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I can tell that they're throwing everything they have at each other.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I want to sing with them right this second.)
What do you think your true feelings are, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I have no idea...
But it sounded like words of support someone gave me a really, really long time ago...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That I want to be more courageous.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I want to become stronger than everyone else...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I can't stay by his side if I don't fully commit.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That's why I decided to give up music for good.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (How was I able to spend all this time without singing?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I knew it... You still love music more than anything.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Singing with her fills me with so much joy and excitement...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Why do I feel so excited all of a sudden?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(It's like when I'm singing with Akito...
No, this sensation goes far beyond that.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (The four of us are singing together for the first time, so why are we meshing together so—)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Yeah, now I get it.
But none of that matters right now.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Man, that was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But also, what's the meaning of all this?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Is this something SEKAI wants us to see?
Or am I just dreaming...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A dream...
What if we're all having the same dream?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I still don't really understand what's going on, but talk about a weird dream.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's hard to believe that we forgot everything we went through together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But I'm glad we all remembered in the end.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Even if this world isn't real...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The thought of not being able to sing with you is just too much to bear, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! I feel the same way!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, there's no way one person is ever gonna be able to surpass RAD WEEKEND all by themselves.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Speaking of which, you're not allowed to disappear like that again.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
But I'm also glad that I remember everything now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The time I spent with you, Akito, everything we experienced as Vivid BAD SQUAD and just how much our music means to us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, so... How do we get out of here?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I can't seem to find “Untitled” on my phone.
I was hoping that we could contact Miku and the others...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, it's not on my phone either...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So many questions...
But for now, wanna head over to the cafe? We can think about this situation more there.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That sounds good. It's been so long since I last had Ken's coffee.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But if this is all a dream, is it gonna taste the same?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that the four of us are back together.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Because singing means everything to me now.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(And the dream An gave me...
My dream that everyone helped grow into something much bigger...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I need to make sure to never forget it again.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I want to keep chasing after the same dream with them.)
